verdict.rationale: Kimi's API platform is /v1 path-versioned, its Admin API spec carries a date-based version, and it publishes a dated model deprecation table with migration guidance. There is no standalone deprecation-policy document and no API changelog, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half rests on a per-model table rather than a formal policy. missing for 10: a standalone deprecation-policy document with notice periods, an API changelog, independent or hands-on corroboration of deprecation handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API is /v1 path-versioned (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible bases) and the platform publishes a dated model deprecation table with migration guidance covering API model IDs
